hubs.description: An employee of the business, uniquely and consistently identified for all HR reporting. Anchored on the national identification number, the strongest natural business identifier for a person (REQ-002).
hubs.name: hub_employee

satellites.description: Overwritten, non-sensitive descriptive attributes of an employee whose succession of values the warehouse captures as changes occur: job title, marital status handle, active/inactive flag and hierarchy depth level (REQ-006, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-022, REQ-067).
satellites.name: sat_employee_profile
satellites.split_rationale: Overwritten non-PII operational attributes grouped together; split from PII (demographics) by data classification and from stable facts (hire date, salaried flag) by rate of change. MaritalStatus is PII-adjacent but recorded here alongside status; see sat_employee_demographics for restricted personal data.

satellites.description: Restricted personal data attributes — date of birth, gender and marital status — whose warehouse access must be limited to authorised HR users (REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-014, REQ-015, REQ-016).
satellites.name: sat_employee_demographics
satellites.split_rationale: Split out by data classification (PII / sensitivity) so access can be restricted to authorised HR users independently of other employee attributes.
